Initial release of influencer-campaign-monitoring skill.

- Supports campaign monitoring for TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.
- Provides unified APIs for monitoring task lifecycle: create, list, detail, refresh, and stop.
- Enables retrieval of key user metrics and bulk downloading of tracked assets per platform.
- Introduces post-campaign review contract: status, trend, anomalies, and recommendations.
- Handles quota limits and informs users when free quota is exhausted.
